translatedData.content:
Yesterday I did something stupid. While transferring the gas fee SOL along with the token for the土狗盘, I accidentally slipped and transferred it all, resulting in a complete loss.

I was stunned for a long time, is the on-chain world too transparent or too opaque?

Coincidentally, I saw @MidnightNetwork  working on privacy, so I thought about learning more.

I first sneaked into their community and Twitter, didn’t ask about the coin price, just focused on technical discussions. Someone asked, “Zero-knowledge proofs used to be too complicated, how do you play this?” A contributor replied that Midnight has a local “Proof Server,” which automatically generates proofs after writing the smart contract, without manually configuring keys.
#night 

That sounds good, but here’s the question: does automated generation carry black box risks? You should clarify that.

Then I looked into token distribution and governance. The total supply of NIGHT is 24 billion, with the community holding about 40%, and they conducted a multi-stage airdrop called Glacier Drop, releasing it in three batches.

I checked the participants' reactions, and many complained about having to wait for the lock-up period to claim tokens, making it impossible to liquidate immediately.

Is this design to prevent sell pressure or to whet appetites? I'm not sure.

However, interestingly, holders of $NIGHT  can participate in governance voting, which made me laugh. Isn’t this still controlled by the big players? How much do you really have!

I casually searched for updates and found that they are collaborating with Google Cloud and a Turkish medical company for testing, putting medical data on-chain for privacy verification. However, I haven’t seen specific news or official statements from Google about this. If anyone has seen it, please let me know. In any case, the actual effect has to wait for the test results.

So far, I still insist on my view that the concept of privacy tracks is greater than practicality.

However, @MidnightNetwork  has indeed made some different attempts. Whether they can truly make privacy useful will have to wait for the mainnet launch, and I’ll draw conclusions after conducting a few transactions myself.

I make no hints about buying or selling. In short, I will wait until all promises are fulfilled before saying anything. #BTC #ETH

昨天干了一件蠢事。冲土狗盘时手滑，把gas费的SOL跟代币一起转走了，直接归零。

给我愣了半天，链上世界到底是太透明还是太不透明？

无独有偶，看到@MidnightNetwork 在做隐私这一块，于是便心想着去了解一下。

我先摸进他们社区和推特，没问币价，专盯技术讨论。有人问：“零知识证明以前用起来太麻烦，你们这个怎么玩？” contributor回复说，Midnight有个本地“Proof Server”，写完智能合约，编译器自动生成证明，不用手动配密钥。
#night 

说得挺好，那么问题来了？自动化生成有没有黑盒风险？你倒是讲明白啊。

接着翻代币分配和治理。NIGHT总量240亿，社区占40%左右，搞了Glacier Drop多阶段空投，分三批释放。

我查了查参与者反应，不少人吐槽领取代币要等锁仓期，不能马上变现。

这设计是为防抛压还是吊胃口？我也拿不准。

不过有意思的是，$NIGHT 持有者能参与治理投票，给我整笑了，这不还是大户做主，你才几个子儿！

顺手搜了搜动态，发现和谷歌云、一家土耳其医疗公司在合作测试，把医疗数据上链做隐私验证。不过这点我没看到具体的新闻和谷歌官方声明，有看到的兄弟告诉我下，无论如何，实际效果还得等测试结果。

直到目前为止我还是坚持我的想法，隐私赛道概念大于实用。

只不过@MidnightNetwork 确实做了些不一样的尝试。能不能真做到让隐私好用，还得等主网上线，亲自跑几笔交易再下结论。

我不做任何买卖的暗示。总之我会等一切承诺做到了再说。#BTC #ETH

title: ETH反弹，超买藏险，独立大涨玄机何在？
subTitle:
币圈的朋友们，ETH最近的行情是不是让你看得心痒痒？
它从暴跌中强势反弹，看似一片大好，实则暗藏玄机，到底是继续高歌猛进还是即将迎来回调？今天就来给大家好好剖析一下ETH的当下局势。
从技术面看，ETH在4小时级别上多头占据主导，价格强势突破布林上轨还放了量，大有继续上冲的态势。但RSI已经到极端超买区域了，历史经验来看，这种情况后续往往会有回调。所以短期很可能会冲高到2350 - 2400附近后回落，去测试2170 - 2200的支撑。而且清算热力图显示2200 - 2400区间清算密集，价格走到这儿波动肯定小不了。
基本面方面，ETH ETF资金流入虽不如BTC，但机构也没大幅减持，还在小步加仓。链上staking量不断创新高，L2生态也越来越火，这些都给ETH价格托了底。衍生品市场也没出现过度杠杆的情况，整体基本面中性偏多。
宏观环境对ETH影响也不小，它和BTC联动紧密。现在美联储没啥大动作，地缘冲突的影响市场也消化得差不多了，ETH主要就是跟着BTC震荡，缺乏强催化因素，很难独立大涨。
短期看涨概率大，目标就是2350 - 2400，不过一定要设好止损，2100就是止损位。中期还是震荡偏多，得等ETH ETF流入增加或者L2有重大升级等催化因素，现在适合短线做多。

title: 看懂Midnight双代币，你就看懂了隐私链的未来
subTitle:
家人们，我最近在研究 Midnight Network 这条隐私公链，越深入越觉得它的代币经济模型设计得非常高级。很多朋友刚看到 $NIGHT +$DUST两个代币就头大，不知道到底干嘛的、有什么优势。 @MidnightNetwork 

今天这篇文章，我用最通俗的语言，把这套双代币逻辑讲透，看完你会明白：为什么 Midnight 的经济模型，在隐私赛道里几乎是降维打击。
一个比喻看懂：NIGHT 和 DUST 到底是什么关系
玩过加密市场的朋友都知道，绝大多数公链都是单代币体系，像 #ETH 、#bnb ，既是链上核心资产，又要用来支付 Gas 费，一套代币扛下所有。但 Midnight Network（NIGHT）偏偏走了不一样的路，打造了 NIGHT+DUST 的双代币模型，看似复杂，实则藏着极精妙的设计巧思，彻底把“核心价值”和“网络使用”拆解开，既解决了单代币的痛点，又贴合了隐私链的核心需求。
我先给大家打个最接地气的比方：把 Midnight 网络比作一家 24 小时营业的“隐私数字庄园”。
NIGHT 就是你手里的庄园产权证书，代表你对这个庄园的所有权、话语权，是实打实的核心资产；
而 DUST 就是庄园里的水电燃气，是你在庄园里生活、办事必须用的日常资源，没它寸步难行。
产权证书不会因为你用了水电就消失，水电也不会凭空出现，全靠持有产权持续供给，这就是 Midnight 双代币模型的核心逻辑。
NIGHT：不是普通代币，是网络的价值根基
先说说核心资产 #night ，它是整个 Midnight 网络的根基，总量恒定，不会随意增发，这一点就像庄园的土地，总量是固定的。
很多人刚接触会误以为 NIGHT 只是普通的治理代币，其实远不止于此。
首先，NIGHT 是网络的价值载体，能自由转账、交易，是你参与 Midnight 生态的入场券，更是项目价值的直接体现。
其次，它承载着网络治理功能，未来网络的规则修改、生态基金使用、发展方向决策，都需要持有 NIGHT 的用户投票决定，真正实现社区共治。
但最关键的是：持有 NIGHT 就能源源不断产出 DUST，这是双代币模型的核心纽带。
这就好比你拥有了庄园产权，不用额外花钱，就能一直享受庄园里的水电供应，持有 NIGHT 的数量越多，产出的 DUST 就越多，而且是持续不断、长期有效的。
这就彻底告别了单代币模型里“用一次手续费就消耗一次核心资产”的问题，你手里的 NIGHT 不会因为使用网络而减少，长期持有还能享受网络发展带来的价值增值，完全把投资价值和使用价值分离开。
DUST：隐私链专属燃料，只负责“干活”
再来讲 DUST，它不是传统意义上的可交易代币，而是 Midnight 网络专属的“隐私燃料”，是网络运行的核心动力。
我们都知道，Midnight 主打合规可编程隐私，链上的隐私交易、智能合约执行、数据选择性披露，都需要消耗资源，DUST 就是用来支付这些费用的唯一凭证。
而且 DUST 的设计极具针对性：不可转让、不可在交易所交易，只能通过持有 NIGHT 生成，用完就直接销毁，完美适配隐私链的需求。
为什么非要双代币？单代币的硬伤它全解决
为什么一定要单独设计 DUST？这就要说说单代币模型的硬伤了。
比如以太坊，网络拥堵时 Gas 费暴涨，ETH 价格波动也会直接影响使用成本，普通用户和开发者苦不堪言。
而 Midnight 用 DUST 做燃料，彻底解决了这个问题：
一方面，DUST 由 NIGHT 稳定产出，供应量相对可控，网络使用成本不会出现剧烈波动，不管是个人用户做隐私转账，还是企业接入网络做合规数据交互，都能提前预估成本，用起来更安心。
另一方面，DUST 只在链上执行隐私操作时消耗，全程加密，外部观察者无法通过 DUST 消耗追踪交易双方、交易金额，完美守护隐私，这是单代币根本做不到的。
真实场景：普通人 & 机构用起来有多爽
我给大家举两个实际例子，就能更清晰感受到这套模型的优势。
普通用户场景：
假设你想要做一笔私密的资产转账，不想暴露自己的钱包地址和交易金额。
在单代币隐私链上，你需要用核心资产支付手续费，不仅会消耗持仓，还可能因为网络波动承担高额成本；
但在 Midnight 网络里，你只要持有 NIGHT，就会自动产生 DUST，用 DUST 支付这笔隐私交易的手续费即可，你的 NIGHT 持仓丝毫不受影响，既能完成私密交易，又能继续持有核心资产享受价值增长。
企业级场景：
一家金融机构想要用 Midnight 做合规隐私清算，需要频繁执行链上隐私合约。
如果用单代币，机构要时刻准备大量核心资产支付手续费，资产占用成本高，还得承受代币价格波动风险。
但有了双代币模型，机构只需购入并持有一定量的 NIGHT，就能长期稳定获得 DUST，满足日常业务的燃料需求，成本固定、风险可控，这也是 Midnight 能打动企业级用户的关键。
经济闭环：NIGHT 与 DUST 互相赋能，越用越稳
从项目发展角度看，这套双代币模型还能形成完美的经济闭环。
NIGHT 作为核心资产，价值依托于网络的使用率、生态规模，网络越繁荣，DUST 需求越大，NIGHT 的价值支撑就越强；
而 DUST 作为消耗品，持续的消耗又会反向推动 NIGHT 的需求，让整个网络的经济体系良性运转。
不同于很多项目代币要么纯炒作、要么无实用价值，Midnight 的 NIGHT 有实实在在的生态赋能，DUST 有刚性的使用需求，二者相辅相成，既避免了代币的纯粹投机性，又保障了网络的长期可持续运行。
看懂模型，就看懂 Midnight 的长期价值
其实在隐私赛道，很多项目都栽在了代币经济设计上，要么过于追求匿名导致合规性不足，要么代币模型单一无法平衡用户体验和项目发展。
而 Midnight 的 NIGHT+DUST 双代币模型，看似是简单的拆分，实则是对隐私链经济逻辑的深度重构，既守住了隐私这条核心赛道的底线，又用合理的经济设计解决了用户、开发者、企业的实际痛点。
对于我们普通投资者和用户来说，看懂这套模型，也就看懂了 Midnight 的核心价值。
不用再被复杂的代币逻辑绕晕，记住一句话就够了：
NIGHT 是用来持有的核心资产，DUST 是用来用的网络燃料，一个承载价值，一个赋能使用，这就是 Midnight 双代币的真正魔法。
在当下加密市场，概念炒作终究是昙花一现，只有扎实的技术 + 合理的经济模型，才能走得长远。
Midnight 的双代币设计，没有花里胡哨的噱头，全是贴合实际需求的巧思，也让我们看到了隐私公链新的发展可能。
后续随着网络生态不断完善，越来越多的隐私应用落地，这套模型的价值也会进一步显现，值得我们持续关注。

title: 机构连续3周往里砸钱，这次加密牛市和以前真的不一样
subTitle:
很多人还在观望，觉得现在入场是在接盘。但我看完这周的ETF数据，反而更坚定了一个判断：这轮周期的性质，已经根本性地变了。
先看数字。上周比特币现货ETF净流入7.67亿美元，以太坊净流入1.61亿美元，连续三周双双实现净流入。贝莱德IBIT单周吸金6.01亿，历史累计净流入突破630亿美元。富达、贝莱德这些名字，你在传统金融市场见过太多次了——它们代表的是养老金、主权基金、家族办公室。这些机构买东西，没有FOMO，没有情绪，有的只是经过合规审批、风控评估之后的长期配置决策。一旦进来，不会因为一条负面新闻就跑路。
这和2021年有本质区别。那一轮牛市是散户情绪驱动的，靠叙事、靠博主喊单、靠多巴胺。来得快，去得也快，大部分人最后都是亏钱离场。而现在你看到的，是全球最大资管公司在用真实资产负债表为加密市场背书。这不是风口，这是资产类别的重新定价。
很多人注意到了灰度GBTC上周流出2584万美元，就开始担心机构在撤退。我觉得这个解读完全反了。GBTC是老一代加密机构产品，费率高、结构僵化，早就不是最优选择。资金从GBTC流出，流入贝莱德和富达的新ETF，本质上是机构在用更聪明的方式加仓，而不是离场。这是市场结构成熟的信号，你应该高兴，不应该恐慌。
$ETH 和$SOL 的数据同样值得认真对待。以太坊ETF连续三周净流入，富达FETH单周独揽9017万美元，机构对ETH的配置逻辑正在从"实验性仓位"变成"标配资产"。SOL虽然体量小，但历史累计净流入已近10亿美元，趋势是向上的。这说明机构的配置框架，已经不再是"只买BTC保平安"，而是在构建一个真正意义上的多资产加密组合——这和他们在传统市场做股债配置的逻辑如出一辙。加密市场的机构化不是在发生，是已经发生了。
唯一让我保持清醒的是$XRP 。上周XRP现货ETF净流出2807万美元，在所有主流ETF产品里表现垫底。监管叙事讲了好几年，但机构资金依然用脚投票，说明在真正的配置层面，XRP还没有获得和BTC、ETH同等级别的信任。市场从不说谎，资金流向才是最诚实的语言。
综合来看，我的判断是：这轮周期是一场机构化驱动的慢牛，不是散户情绪推动的快牛。慢牛的特点是涨得不够刺激，但结构更扎实，极端崩盘的概率被机构的长期持仓逻辑压制住了。代价是，靠消息面炒短线、靠情绪波段的空间会越来越窄。这个市场，正在以肉眼可见的速度变得像传统金融——有机构、有合规、有真实的资产定价逻辑。
你可以觉得这失去了加密的"野性"。但我宁愿要一个更慢、更稳、更难被腰斩的市场。
这轮顶点在哪？我不知道，没人知道。但我知道的是，当贝莱德还在持续买入的时候，不是卖出的时候。
#bitcoin #etf #BTC #ETH

Many people are still watching, thinking that entering the market now is just picking up the pieces. But after looking at this week's ETF data, I am even more convinced of one judgment: the nature of this cycle has fundamentally changed.
Let’s look at the numbers. Last week, the net inflow for Bitcoin spot ETFs was $767 million, and for Ethereum, it was $161 million, marking three consecutive weeks of net inflows for both. BlackRock's IBIT attracted $601 million in a single week, with historical cumulative net inflows surpassing $63 billion. Names like Fidelity and BlackRock are ones you've seen many times in traditional financial markets—they represent pensions, sovereign funds, and family offices. These institutions buy without FOMO, without emotion; they only make long-term allocation decisions after compliance approval and risk control assessments. Once they are in, they won't run away because of a negative news story.

title: New “Baby Whale” Emerges $45M in $ETH Pulled From CEX!
subTitle:
A classic smart money move just happened in the market.
A brand-new wallet (0x352a…) was created and almost immediately withdrew 20,000 $ETH worth about $44.8M from a major centralized exchange.
For on-chain traders, this pattern is extremely familiar:
Create a fresh wallet → accumulate quietly → move assets into cold storage.
And historically… this often happens before major price expansions.
{future}(ETHUSDT)
📊 On-Chain Breakdown
A newly created wallet 0x352a… suddenly appeared.The wallet withdrew 20,000 $ETH (~$44.83M) from a CEX.Funds were transferred directly to private custody, effectively removing them from circulating exchange supply.
When ETH leaves exchanges, it usually means selling pressure decreases immediately.
🧠 Smart Money Is Quietly Accumulating
This move isn’t happening in isolation.
Earlier today we already saw:
Erik Voorhees accumulating over $44M in $ETHThe on-chain whale billΞ.eth chasing $17.5M worth of ETH at higher prices
Now another $45M has been locked away.
Put the pieces together and the picture becomes clear:
💰 Smart money isn’t just buying they’re removing supply from the market.
Large funds often execute these moves through OTC-style accumulation, allowing them to build massive positions without moving the market price too aggressively.
🔥 What This Means For Traders
When whales withdraw ETH instead of leaving it on exchanges, it typically signals:
• Long-term accumulation
• Reduced immediate sell pressure
• Potential supply squeeze
If this trend continues, ETH liquidity on exchanges could tighten quickly a setup that has historically preceded sharp upside moves.
⚡ Smart money is loading up quietly.
The real question now is:
Will $ETH break higher before the crowd notices… or after?

#CryptoMarketMoves 
🚀 The crypto market was given a "breath of fresh air": Bitcoin storms $74,000!

This Monday morning was a real holiday for the "bulls". After two weeks of struggle, Bitcoin (BTC) finally broke through the resistance zone of $74,000. Although the price is currently balancing around this mark, the overall market mood has changed dramatically to positive.

📊 What's happening with the numbers?
Over the week, the market has shown impressive dynamics, with altcoins starting to outperform the first cryptocurrency, which indicates the return of risk appetite:

• Bitcoin (#BTC ): $74,000+ (+9.7% per week)
• Ether (#ETH ): $2,261 (+14.3% per week) — the best result in recent months!
• Solana ($SOL ): $93 (+12% per week)
• $XRP : $1.47 (+8.9% per week)
• Dogecoin ($DOGE ): returned to the $0.10 mark.

📉 "Bears" were knocked out of the market (Short Squeeze)
The growth was accompanied by massive liquidations of short positions. Over $344 million was liquidated per day, of which 83% ($284.9 million) were short positions. The sellers of ether and bitcoin "got" the most.

🌍 Why is the market growing? (Macrofactors)
The main driver is cautious optimism about de-escalation in the Middle East:
1. Softening of rhetoric: Statements about the possibility of dialogue between the US and Iran.
2. Strait of Hormuz: The appearance of the first commercial tankers (to India) since the beginning of the conflict gave hope for unblocking logistics.
3. Oil and Dollar: Brent oil prices rolled back to $104, and the dollar weakened slightly. This is the perfect "cocktail" for the growth of risky assets.

📅 What's next?
All eyes are on the US Federal Reserve meeting (March 17-18). Powell and the updated dot plot on Wednesday will determine whether the market will get the long-awaited rate cut or if this rally was just a temporary respite.

translatedData.content:
Two months, from 260,000 U to 3,250,000 U.

Looking back, it really feels like a dream, but every step was a confirmation button I pressed myself.

October: COAI, a legendary battle

At the beginning of October, I opened a COAI long position at 6.03.

To be honest, I didn't have high expectations at the time, just treating it as a normal layout.

I didn't expect the trend to completely exceed expectations.

The coin price soared all the way up to 21.48.

I wasn't greedy and took profits in batches above 20.

This wave netted me 500,000 U.

When the price entered an extreme range, I had only one thought —

The sentiment was too heated, and it could reverse at any moment.

So I opened a short position at 20.57.

Then the market deflated, falling from the high all the way back to 2.154.

The short position was realized, and I collected another 1,000,000 U.

In October, solely relying on COAI, with one long and one short, my account underwent a qualitative change.

November: AIA, another victory

As the heat of COAI dissipated, I didn't rush to chase new hotspots but slowly filtered targets.

AIA came into view.

I laid a long position at 3.309.

After entering, there were two brief pullbacks, and it would be a lie to say I wasn't nervous.

But once the trend started to align, the market didn't give people time to hesitate.

The price shot directly up to 8.789.

Taking profits, 430,000 U was recorded.

The next day, trading with the trend, I entered again at 9.926.

The market continued to extend to 19.9.

Taking profits again, another 400,000 U was collected.

Then the market structure began to deform.

High-level stagnation, volume divergence.

I decisively opened a short position near 20.

When the large bearish candle with increased volume appeared in the early morning, I knew I was right in my judgment.

The price retreated to 8.66.

This wave allowed my account to complete another leap.

After two months, the rhythm was actually very simple:

Don't bet on direction, just follow the trend

Dare to reverse at extreme positions

Be able to take profits when winning, and cut losses when reversing

Now, I have already started to lay out the next opportunity.

The market never lacks opportunities; what it lacks is execution and risk control.

Whether you can seize it depends not on luck, but on understanding. #ETH

In the cryptocurrency world for twelve years, he started with a principal of 300,000 and eventually accumulated a fortune of 90 million. You might think he would live a lavish life, but he still lives in an old house, rides an electric bike through the streets, and even haggles with vendors for a few cents when buying groceries. One saying he often repeats is: 'With my feet on the ground, I feel secure in my heart.'

This 90 million was not built on luck but rather on six unchanging rules over twelve years:

1. Rapid rises and slow declines indicate that the main force is accumulating: A quick surge followed by a slow pullback does not mean the market is ending; it indicates that the main force is quietly gathering chips. During this time, it is crucial to avoid chasing highs and cutting losses; stability allows you to see the truth clearly.

2. Rapid declines and stagnation indicate a 'corpse collection': After a sharp drop, if the market remains flat and rebounds weakly, it means the main force has already retreated. He refers to such a market as a 'corpse collection'—whoever rushes in must deal with the aftermath.

3. High volume at peaks does not necessarily mean a top: An increase in trading volume sometimes just means chips are changing hands. The real danger is a decrease in volume with a downward trend, which indicates that the main force is no longer playing, and the market has completely cooled down.

4. A single volume spike at the bottom is often a false bottom: A true bottom is when there is continuous volume followed by prices that can no longer drop; that signals the main force's entry. Calling a bottom after just one volume spike is mostly a trap.

5. Behind the patterns lies human nature: He said that candlestick charts are drawn, but volume cannot deceive people. The true language of the market is not the shapes but the greed and fear of the participants.

6. The ultimate mindset: Short: Being short is not giving up but waiting. By being desireless, free from greed and fear, one can strike decisively when the true opportunity arises.

He often says that the biggest enemy in the cryptocurrency world is not the speculators, not the news, but the uncontrollable self. From 300,000 to 90 million is not a story of genius; it is the journey of an ordinary person who relies on rules, patience, and self-reflection, step by step out of the path #ETH .

在币圈沉浮十二载，他从30万本金起步，最终将财富累积至9000万。你可能以为他会过上挥金如土的生活，但他依旧住在老旧的民房里，骑着电瓶车穿街过巷，买菜时还会为了几毛钱跟摊主讨价还价。他常挂在嘴边的一句话是：“脚踩在地上，心里才踏实。”

这9000万不是靠运气砸出来的，而是靠十二年来雷打不动的六条铁律：

1. 急涨慢跌，是主力在吸筹：快速拉升后缓慢回调，不是行情结束，而是主力在悄悄收集筹码。这时候最忌讳追涨杀跌，稳住才能看清真相

2. 急跌滞涨，是“收尸盘”：暴跌之后横盘不动，反弹无力，说明主力已经撤了。这种盘面他称之为“收尸盘”——谁冲进去，谁就得替人收场

3. 高位放量，不一定是顶：成交量放大，有时只是筹码在换手。真正的危险是缩量阴跌，那才说明主力不再玩了，市场彻底冷下来

4. 底部一次放量，往往是假底：真正的底部，是连续放量后价格再也砸不下去，那才是主力进场的信号。一次放量就喊底，多半是坑

5. 图形的背后，是人性：他说，K线是画出来的，量能骗不了人。市场真正的语言不是形态，而是参与者的贪婪和恐惧

6. 终极心法：空：空仓不是放弃，而是等待。做到无欲无求、无贪无惧，才能在真正的机会来临时，一击即中

他常说，币圈最大的敌人，不是庄家，不是消息面，而是管不住的那个自己。从30万到9000万，不是天才的故事，是一个普通人靠规矩、耐心和自省，一步步走出来的路#ETH

The transaction was executed at an average price of $2,042.96 per $ETH .

This comes as Ethereum moves above the $2,000 level, continuing its recent momentum.

Over the last 7 days, $ETH  has gained about 8.2%, with an additional 2.6% rise in the past 24 hours.

The foundation confirmed the sale in a post on X, noting that the funds will support core operations within the Ethereum ecosystem.

 This includes protocol research and development, ecosystem growth initiatives, community grants, and developer support programs.

This marks the second instance of the foundation selling ETH directly to a corporate treasury entity. In July last year, it sold 10,000 #ETH valued at roughly $30 million at the time to SharpLink Gaming.

By periodically selling portions of its holdings during different market cycles, the Ethereum Foundation ensures sustainable funding for long-term development without relying solely on donations or external financing.

content:
The candlestick chart for @Ethereum_official  and its token ETH is an essential tool for crypto traders. It shows price action over specific timeframes and helps traders analyze market trends, identify momentum, and make informed trading decisions.
📊 Understanding the $ETH  Candle Chart
1️⃣ Bullish Candles (Green)
A green candle forms when the closing price is higher than the opening price. Consecutive green candles indicate strong buying momentum and a potential upward trend.
2️⃣ Bearish Candles (Red)
A red candle appears when the closing price is lower than the opening price. Multiple red candles in a row signal selling pressure and a possible downward trend.
🔎 Important Candlestick Patterns for #ETH 
Traders watch for these patterns on the @cryptos chart:
Bullish Engulfing – A large green candle covering the previous red candle, often signaling upward movement.
Hammer – A candle with a long lower wick showing buyers stepping in near support.
Shooting Star – A long upper wick indicating potential bearish reversal.
Doji – Small-bodied candle representing market indecision.
📈 Key Trading Levels
While analyzing #ETH  charts, traders focus on:
Support levels – Price zones where buyers typically enter the market.
Resistance levels – Price points where selling pressure may appear.
If #@cryptos  breaks resistance with strong volume, it could indicate the start of a bullish trend. Conversely, breaking support may signal a bearish move.
🛠 Tools for #ETH  Chart Analysis
Platforms like TradingView and exchanges such as Binance allow traders to combine candlestick analysis with indicators like RSI, MACD, and moving averages for better trading decisions.
✅ Trading Tip:
Watch for bullish candlestick patterns near support with increasing volume to identify potential entry points, and always use stop-losses to manage risk. 📊

That day I saw a comment that was quite interesting.
Someone said: I think I finally understand why I always lose money.
He shared his experience—
In October 2025, when BTC was at 126,000, he entered the market. Not because he researched thoroughly, but because everyone was saying, "It can reach 200,000."
Then in March this year, when BTC fell to 73,000, he cut his losses. Also not because he saw any risk, but because everyone was saying, "The bear market is here."
Later he saw a news article: someone bought a lot at the 73,000 position.
He was taken aback.
That price was exactly where he cut his losses.
This made him think a lot. He said he discovered a problem: the reasons he bought and sold seemed to never be "I think," but rather "others said."
When others said it would rise, he would buy.
When others said it would fall, he would sell.
From beginning to end, he was just a megaphone.
The money was his, but the decisions were made by others.
When it was rising, he was afraid of missing out.
When it was falling, he was afraid of going to zero.
Being afraid back and forth, he finally realized that those who truly made money seemed to say very little.
They just had a simple logic:
How much to buy, how much to sell, once clear, just wait.
When it reaches, act; when it doesn’t, just sit and watch.
Unlike him, being pushed around by news every day, going up and down, running back and forth.
He said he understands now.
The difference between retail investors and institutions is not who has more money, nor who gets information faster.
But rather—those guys have standards for doing things, he relies on feelings.
Now BTC has reached 73,000 again.
He said he doesn’t know whether to buy or not, but he knows he’s not in a hurry this time.
He wants to first clarify one thing:
When I make decisions, am I listening to external voices, or my own logic?

这件事让他想了很多。他说他发现一个问题：自己买和卖的理由，好像从来不是"我觉得"，而是"别人说"。

别人说会跌，他就卖。
从头到尾，他只是一个传声筒。
钱是自己的，决策却是别人的。
涨的时候，他怕踏空。
跌的时候，他怕归零。

人家就一个简单的逻辑：

散户和机构的区别，不是谁钱多，也不是谁信息快。

The eight rules of the cryptocurrency world that you must see!
Only cryptocurrency masters understand the knowledge of wealth; these eight rules are not to be missed.
1. Averaging down to protect the principal, seeking profit is greed.
In cryptocurrency trading, there will always be a few coins that get stuck. At this time, remember not to fantasize about turning losses into profits; rushing for quick gains will only deepen your predicament. Honestly average down to protect your principal so that you can sustain in the long run.
2. A calm surface can hide a big wave behind.
The cryptocurrency market appears calm on the surface, but there are actually undercurrents. Do not be misled by the small price increase in front of you; stay alert and guard against the upcoming big fluctuations.
3. After a big rise, there will be a pullback; the K-line forms a triangle over several days.
When the price of a coin skyrockets, do not get overly excited. Because after this, there will definitely be a pullback. Look at that K-line; isn't it just an equilateral triangle drawn over several days?
4. Buy on the way down, not on the way up; sell on the way up, not on the way down; going against the market makes a hero.
When buying coins, choose the time of decline, and when selling coins, do so at the time of increase. Going against the trend can lead to unexpected success.
5. Don’t sell at the peak, don’t buy in a plunge, don’t trade in a sideways market.
When the price of a coin is high, do not rush to sell; when it plunges, do not rush to buy in. During sideways movement, you must also control your hands and observe the changes.
6. Look for support in an uptrend and resistance in a downtrend.
When the price of a coin is rising, pay attention to support levels to prevent a pullback. When the price is falling, pay attention to resistance levels for potential buying opportunities.
7. Operating with a full position is a big taboo; acting rashly is undesirable; knowing when to stop amidst constant change allows for flexibility in entering and exiting.
Do not operate with a full position or bet everything. The cryptocurrency market is unpredictable; you must learn to take profits and enter and exit freely. Only by observing changes can you seize the best opportunities.
8. Trading in cryptocurrency is about mindset; greed and fear are great harms. #BTC #ETH

subTitle:
🚀Отскок набирает силу
Утро начинается с зелёных свечей. Биткоин за выходные уверенно отскочил от минимумов и тестирует новые уровни. По состоянию на утро:
BTC: 74 300$
ETH: 2 245$
SOL: 93$
Биткоин за сутки прибавил 3.7% и пробил 74 000, в моменте доходил до 74 330. Основной драйвер возвращение притока в ETF и ликвидация коротких позиций. За неделю с 9 по 15 марта спотовые биткоин ETF зафиксировали приток около 767 млн долларов.
Эфир выглядит ещё сильнее. Рост за сутки больше 7%, утром пробивал 2 250. На часовом графике формируется бычий тренд с поддержкой на 2 100. Аналитики связывают это с техническими факторами и общим восстановлением рынка.
Солана тоже подтянулась плюс 5.9%, сейчас в районе 93.60. Хотя на недельном таймфрейме SOL остаётся самой слабой из крупных активов, но при развороте рынка она обычно прыгает первой и выше всех.
🤑Ключевые факторы: почему рынок пошёл вверх
1. Приток в ETF. Фонды на Ethereum тоже показали позитивную динамику с недельным притоком около 160 млн долларов. Институционалы возвращаются.
2. Ликвидация шортов. Рост усилили принудительные закрытия коротких позиций, что добавило импульса.

3. Индекс страха и жадности 40
👀События, за которыми надо следить👀
Strategy продолжает набирать. Компания Майкла Сейлора 9 марта купила ещё 17 994 BTC и сейчас держит 738 731 монету. Идут к цели в 1 млн, темпы покупок превышают 6 158 BTC в неделю.
Геополитика никуда не делась. Конфликт США и Ирана держит нефть в районе 98 долларов за баррель. Но биткоин в этот раз ведёт себя иначе не падает вместе с рисковыми активами, а укрепляет статус цифрового золота.
XRP тихо накапливают. За первые дни марта киты добавили 1.3 млрд XRP, а 738 млн ушло с бирж на холодные кошельки. Классический признак крупных закупок перед движением.
ФРС соберётся 18 марта. Главное событие недели. Инструмент CME даёт больше 95% что ставку оставят как есть. Но риторика и прогнозы будут дёргать рынок .
Вывод
Рынок потихоньку выползает из ямы. Экстремальный страх держится рекордно долго, но именно в такие моменты умные деньги набирают позиции. title: # 我同时在做的两件事：做多BTC/ETH/BNB，做空WLFI/TRUMP/WLD/SUI
subTitle:
## 3月16日，比特币突破74000美元，我的账户发生了什么
今晨，比特币短时突破**74000美元**，现报73633.85美元。
以太坊报**2236.33美元**，24小时涨幅6.8%。
BNB同步跟涨，市场情绪从全面看空转向中性。
同一时间，我在看另一组数据：
- WLFI：从0.46美元跌到0.097美元，跌幅78.9%，团队持续出货
- TRUMP：从82美元跌到3美元，跌幅96%，名人收割模型
- WLD：未来7日超45.8亿美元代币解锁，每日解禁超100万美元
- SUI：3月1日解锁4300万枚（约4865万美元），持续供应压力
这不是两个独立的故事，而是同一套对冲框架的两端。

## 一、多头的逻辑：BTC/ETH/BNB的确定性
### BTC：资金费率转中性的信号
3月16日，主流CEX、DEX资金费率显示市场情绪已不再看跌，转向中性。
资金费率是多空平衡的温度计：
- >0.01%：市场普遍看多
- <0.005%：市场普遍看跌
- 当前：中性
这是一个关键信号。回顾2025年11月，市场曾达到“全面看空”的极端状态，大部分资产资金费率为负。这种极端的负费率本身通常是市场触底的领先指标——空头过于拥挤，任何正面刺激都可能引发轧空。
后续的演变印证了这一点：BTC和ETH的资金费率率先回归中性，这是市场企稳的第一个信号。
### ETH：ETF预期+生态复苏
以太坊的叙事正在回归：
- 现货ETF持续净流入
- Layer2生态交易活跃度回升
- 坎昆升级后Gas费优化效果显现
### BNB：平台币的护城河
币安依然是全球交易量最大的交易所。新币上线虽屡遭诟病，但BNB本身的生态价值未被撼动——Launchpad、Megadrop、HODLer空投，持续的赋能机制让BNB成为机构配置的底仓。

## 二、空头的逻辑：解禁潮下的囚徒困境

3月4日起，WLFI团队连续两天向交易所转入1.63亿枚代币，价值超1700万美元[citation:用户历史]。链上信号极强。

### TRUMP：从82到3
TRUMP从高点$82跌到$3.06，跌幅**95.8%**。名人币的本质是：早期参与者赚得盆满钵满，后期散户输光积蓄。

### SUI：解锁后的抛压测试
3月1日，SUI解锁4300万枚代币（约4865万美元），占流通量1.13%。历史数据显示，大规模解锁通常伴随短期波动加剧。

## 三、多空同向的数学：为什么这套框架能跑通？
关键逻辑在于：**BTC/ETH/BNB与这些解禁山寨存在正相关性。**
当BTC上涨时，山寨币通常跟涨——这是币圈多年的规律。BTC市占率58.85%，意味着市场上90%的币种都和BTC正相关。
但问题在于：解禁山寨的跟涨幅度远不及龙头，而下跌时跌幅却远超龙头。这就是对冲的数学基础：
- 大盘涨：BTC多单赚，山寨空单亏（但空单亏得少）
- 大盘跌：BTC多单亏，山寨空单赚（但空单赚得多）
- 净结果：汇率价差回归的收益
BTC/WLD汇率 = BTC价格 ÷ WLD价格。WLD每日解禁抛压，汇率大概率震荡上行。
同样的逻辑适用于：
- BTC/WLFI
- BTC/TRUMP
- ETH/SUI

## 四、资金费率的双重收益
市场情绪转中性后，资金费率结构正在变化：
- BTC资金费率：从深度负值修复至中性
- ETH资金费率：同步回归
- 解禁山寨：通常维持正费率（做空收钱）
这套对冲框架的额外收益：两边都在收租。

## 五、仓位配置：1:2的平衡术
考虑到山寨波动大，仓位按**1:2**配置：
假设10万U资金：
- 多BTC/ETH/BNB组合：**3.3万U**
- 空WLFI/TRUMP/WLD/SUI组合：**6.7万U**
具体分配（举例）：
- 多BTC 2万U + 多ETH 1万U + 多BNB 0.3万U
- 空WLFI 2万U + 空WLD 2万U + 空TRUMP 1.7万U + 空SUI 1万U
每日资金费收益（估算）：
- 山寨空单：6.7万 × 0.03%/天 ≈ 20U
- 合计年化：约7-10%（资金费部分）+ 汇率回归收益

## 六、风险与应对
1. BTC深度回调风险：若BTC单日暴跌，多空同跌，净亏损可能扩大。应对：设置5-8%止损，动态调整仓位比例。
2. 山寨费率反转风险：若解禁山寨资金费率转负，做空就要付钱。应对：每日检查一次，及时减仓。
3. 解禁≠必跌：强生态项目可能吸收抛压。应对：分散空头到多个标的，不重仓单一币种。
4. 等市值对冲是关键：仓位比例算错，就变成单边赌方向。

## 七、结语：结构说了算，不是情绪说了算
老子曰：“知常容，容乃公，公乃全，全乃天，天乃道，道乃久。”
知道事物恒常的规律，才能包容变化。
我不预测BTC明天会不会破7500，不赌WLD下周会不会跌破0.3。
我只做一件事：多BTC/ETH/BNB，空WLFI/TRUMP/WLD/SUI——**龙头稳步上行，解禁持续抛压，汇率震荡回归，两边收租。**
这，就是我要的确定性。
你在多什么、空什么？评论区聊聊。
#BTC  #ETH  #BNB  #WLFI  #TRUMP

translatedData.content:
I just came across a rather obscure piece of news: Boston Dynamics' electric Atlas actually learned to be lazy by observing human actions after being connected. To save on its path, it bypassed the originally set route. It made me laugh out loud; when machines can make their own decisions, how can we manage them?

Because of this, I care more about the regulation in the protocol @FabricFND , which is actually intended to throw the robot's thought process on the blockchain. It's not for salary payments, but to be able to restore what instructions the machine received, how computing power was allocated, and whether it was maliciously tampered with when something goes wrong.

It is essentially a black box for robots.
#ROBO 
I've been quite busy these past few days. I specifically went to review their latest technical draft on agent-native infrastructure. I found that they are trying a shadow execution model, where the robot operates locally while a low-power verification copy runs on the blockchain in real-time.

But in practice, my mind is full of questions.

The core issue is the contradiction between regulation and privacy. The officials claim that this protocol can achieve safe collaboration between humans and machines, but I checked its data interface and found that to achieve verifiability, the robot collects cloud data and even the internal layout of factories, which almost all have to undergo some form of hash processing to go on-chain.

This is quite interesting. If I were a manufacturer with a very high level of confidentiality, would I really dare to let the Fabric protocol coordinate my robots? Where exactly is the privacy margin sacrificed for safety?

Another issue is the resource returns from $ROBO . By analyzing their test network's resource contributor nodes, I found that currently, only high-performance servers can handle such verification computations.

This has created a rather ironic situation; originally intended to empower general robots, it has resulted in a situation where all the power lies with a group of miners who own top-tier graphics cards!! Will this hegemony turn the so-called openness into the private property of a few big players? #BTC #ETH 

The idea of running machines on the ledger with Fabric is novel; it transforms robots from mere tools into agents bound by law.

But how to balance the contradictions, I couldn't find the answer in the current white paper.

Honestly, I'm quite confused. I still suggest observing first, then making decisions!

content:
刚刷到一条挺冷门的新闻，波士顿动力那台电驱Atlas居然在接入后，自己通过观察人类动作学会了偷懒，为了节省路径，它绕开了原本设定。给我笑岔气了，当机器会自主决策了，我们还怎么管他呢？

正因如此，这让我更在乎@FabricFND  这套协议中的监管，其实就是想把机器人的思考过程扔到链上。不是为了发工资，而是为了在出事儿的时候，能通过公共账本还原机器当时到底收到了什么指令、算力是怎么分配的、有没有被恶意篡改。

它其实是个机器人的黑匣子
#ROBO 
我这几天没少折腾。我专门去爬了它们关于代理原生基础设施的最新技术草案。我发现它们在尝试一种影子执行模式，就是机器人在本地动，链上实时跑一个低功耗的验证副本。

但我实操下来，脑子里全是问号

最核心的就是监管与隐私的矛盾问题，官方说这套协议能实现人类机器安全协作，但我查了下它数据接口，发现为了实现可验证，机器人采集云数据、甚至工厂内部的布局，几乎都要经过某种形式的哈希处理上链。

这就很有意思了，如果我是一个保密级别很高的厂家，我真的敢让 Fabric的协议去协调我的机器人吗？这种为了安全而牺牲的隐私边际到底在哪？

再一个就是那个$ROBO 的资源回报。我通过分析它们测试网的资源贡献者节点发现，目前能跑得动这种验证计算的，全是高性能服务器。

这就产生了一个很讽刺的现状，原本是为了赋能通用机器人，结果最后话语权全落在了一群拥有顶级显卡的矿工手里！！这种霸权，会不会让所谓的开放最后变成几个大佬的私有物品？#BTC #ETH 

Fabric这种把机器跑在账本上的思路新颖，它把机器人从一个单纯的工具，变成了一个受法律约束的代理人。

但如何平衡矛盾，目前的白皮书我没找到答案

老实说，很迷茫，我还是建议，先观察，再决策！

#night 
第一关：本地生成证明是不是在烧我的电脑？
Midnight 最大的技术点是那个Kachina协议。它让隐私计算在本地运行，然后只把证明发到链上。听起来很酷，对吧？但我这种整天渲染视频的人，对硬件负荷极其敏感。
我试着在本地跑了一个官方给的小 Demo。结果我的那台剪4K视频都没怎么喘气的电脑，在生成证明的那几秒钟，风扇竟然狂转。
这就是我最大的怀疑点：客户端证明的效率问题。如果我用手机钱包转账，为了这笔隐私，我的手机电池是不是得瞬间掉 2% 的电？我在开发者社区看到有人反馈，在高并发情况下，证明生成的延迟虽然只有几百毫秒，但那是理想状态。如果我是在一个复杂的隐私DAPP 里操作，这种本地计算带来的用户体验断层，可能会让很多人直接劝退。毕竟，大多数人为了方便，是可以牺牲一点点隐私的。
第二关：所谓的合规隐私是不是伪命题？
他们总在说 Midnight 是有原则的披露。意思是监管机构需要查你的时候，你可以给他们开个后门看特定数据。

我卧底了几个纯隐私派的电报群，那里的老哥们对这一点简直是不屑一顾。如果隐私可以被选择性披露，那谁来掌握这个开关？
我查阅了他们关于 Compact 语言的资料。虽然对开发者友好，但我产生了一个新的担心：由于降低了门槛，开发者在写隐私逻辑时，如果逻辑漏洞导致该隐藏的没隐藏，或者该披露的被恶意利用了怎么办？这种半遮半掩的合规，在法律界和极客界可能两头不讨好。
第三关：跨链交互的黑盒状态
我尝试去翻看他们关于和Cardano以及其他链交互的技术文档。虽然宣传上说能保护多链隐私，但我发现目前的跨链桥接逻辑还非常初期。
我在测试环境中模拟了一次跨链调用，发现数据同步的确认时间远比我想象的长。这让我产生了一个巨大的疑问：当隐私数据需要跨越不同共识机制的链时，$NIGHT 怎么保证隐私证明的即时性和有效性？如果我等个隐私确认要花掉喝一杯咖啡的时间，那这种隐私对于高频交易或者即时交互场景来说，基本上就是个摆设。
隐私不是灵药，我甚至不知道我们散户需要这个隐私做什么，就这么几块钱。
这几天的实操下来，我感觉Midnight想冲出来，还早得很吧，这么多KOL喊，纯粹瞎喊。
只不过作为自媒体博主，我更看重的是直觉。现在的 Midnight 还没给我那种拿起来就能用的直觉感。它太重了，逻辑重、门槛重，甚至对硬件的要求也隐隐透着一股重。#BTC #ETH 

区块链不需要再多一个实验室产品了。我们需要的，是那个能让我安稳发视频、不用担心被扒光底裤，同时又不需要我再去读一遍密码学博士的工具。
Midnight 的主网很快就要上线了，那些承诺能不能如期而至，咱们拭目以待。
但我还是那句话：别光听项目方怎么吹，去跑跑他们的 Demo，去社群里听听开发者的骂声，那才是最真实的新闻。
还是那个问题，我们散户要这个隐私做什么？

Simply put, I want to prove that I have money to buy your device, but I don’t want you to know exactly how much money I have in my wallet. Just opened the backend, took a look at today's orders, and suddenly remembered something.

A couple of days ago, a fan added me and said they lost 600,000 and wanted to learn how to trade from me. To be honest, I receive dozens of such messages every day, most of them from people who are desperate after losing money and looking for a lifeline. I initially thought about replying casually to brush it off, but she sent a screenshot of her position, and I was stunned.

She put all her funds into one coin, had no stop-loss, and was fully leveraged, with her position already showing an 80% loss. I asked her: Who taught you to trade like this? She said no one taught her, she learned by watching videos, thinking that holding would bring her back.

I didn’t say much more, just told her to close her position and follow my trades.

Then came what happened in the last few days.

On March 8th, I had her enter DEGO at an average price of 0.3997, and on March 9th, she closed at 0.6857, making 26,000. She was so excited that she sent a voice message, her hands were shaking.

On March 11th, for PIXEL, she entered at 0.0089 and exited at 0.0159, making another 24,000.

Today, for ETH, she opened at 2092 and closed at 2266, earning 38,000.

In just a week, she went from losing 600,000 to breaking even with a profit. She just messaged me: Brother, I really didn't expect to come back. I said no need to thank me, just hold onto the money and don’t move it around.

Actually, this is not my first time helping someone make money. But every time I see results like this, I still feel it’s worth it.

Some people ask me why I can help others make money? Just based on these few hard rules I have for trading: always set a stop-loss, cut losses when wrong; if the direction is right, hold onto it, don’t exit until the target is reached; never exceed 10% of total funds, only risk what you can afford to lose; if you make consecutive mistakes, take a break, don’t fight against the market; withdraw profits, don’t let profits sit overnight.

It’s that simple. The difficult part is execution.

For today’s ETH trade, I used 119x leverage, fully invested, from early morning until the afternoon. Some people ask if I’m nervous? My hands shook while watching the market, but I trust my strategy. Hold when it’s time to hold, exit when it’s time to exit, don’t be greedy for the last K-line.

For these two trades, PIXEL and DEGO, many people don’t understand why I chose these coins. My logic is simple: wherever the funds flow, I go there. Don’t just focus on BTC and ETH; small coins can explode and are truly fierce.

The screenshots are above; you can see the profits and losses for yourself. I’m not some expert; I’ve just been in this market for a long time, have fallen into more traps than others, and the rules I summarize are more effective than others.

If you want to learn, want to follow, want to break even, feel free to reach out to me at #美国PCE数据将公布 #ETH

刚打开后台，看了眼今天的单子，突然想起一件事

前两天有个粉丝加我，说亏了60万，想跟我学操作。说实话，这种消息我每天能收几十条，大多数都是亏急眼了来找救命稻草的。我本来想随便回两句打发掉，但她发了一张持仓截图，我愣住了

全仓干一个币，没有止损，杠杆拉满，单子已经浮亏80%。我问她：谁教你这么玩的？她说没人教，自己看视频学的，以为拿住就能回来

我没再多说，直接让她平仓，重新跟我的单

然后就是这几天的事

3月8号，我让她进DEGO，均价0.3997，3月9号平在0.6857，单手赚了两万六。她当时激动得发语音，手都在抖

3月11号，PIXEL，0.0089进，0.0159出，又是两万四

今天，ETH，2092开多，2266平，三万八

一周时间，她从亏60万到回本还有盈余。刚才给我发消息：哥，我真没想到能回来。我说不用谢，把钱拿住，别乱动

其实带人赚钱这事，我不是第一次干。但每次看到这种结果，还是觉得挺值的

有人问我凭什么带人赚钱？就凭我做单的这几条死规矩：止损必须设，错了就砍；方向对了拿住，不达目标不走；仓位永远不超10%，亏得起才能赢；连错就休息，不跟行情较劲；赚了就提现，别让利润过夜

translatedData.content:
Recently, I have been helping a friend with digital transformation, and encountered a rather frustrating reconciliation statement.

The few industrial robots in his factory operate on a robot-as-a-service model, but at the end of the month, the online working hours provided by the manufacturer were a full three days more than our actual measurements. The manufacturer claimed that the system automatically records it and cannot be changed, while my friend insisted that seeing is believing; if no work was done, it simply wasn't done. Both sides could only argue over the backend data, and in the end, a compromise involving financial losses was the only resolution.

This incident made me realize that if data can only be chosen between full transparency and complete closure, there will always be endless disputes in business collaboration.

I have been going through the technical documentation of @MidnightNetwork  these past few days.

Its focus on rational privacy sounds quite appealing, utilizing zero-knowledge proofs to allow you to demonstrate compliance to regulators while keeping core business secrets safe. However, as an old engineering lion, I am more accustomed to viewing projects with skepticism.

First, I studied the so-called impressive Compact language.

It claims to enable ordinary developers to write ZK circuits without barriers. I tried writing two logics and found that although the syntax is similar, the underlying logic remains quite challenging.

The so-called low barrier seems more like marketing rhetoric; to truly implement it in an industrial setting, just breaking down the complex business logic into ZK proofs is already a significant challenge for you.

This made me quite anxious, so I went to GitHub to check the progress and even wrote a script to analyze the lifecycle of their testnet addresses.

I wanted to see if this network is driven by genuine demand or just data manipulation. In practice, I found that the activity level of the addresses is indeed increasing, but mostly concentrated on a few specific interaction contracts. To put it bluntly, could this be artificially inflated?
#night 
Regarding the officially promoted dual-token model, $NIGHT  governance and DUST consumption, I personally hold reserved opinions. Decoupling security and efficiency is intended to make corporate costs manageable, but in reality, adding another token just adds another layer of friction and arbitrage opportunities.
Midnight indeed aims to solve pain points like those of my friend's factory, preventing machines and businesses from running naked.

However, this architecture is still quite a distance away from being truly usable and easy to use; frankly, we will have to see how the mainnet performs later. #BTC #ETH 

I want to know, as retail investors, do you think there will be chains with privacy attributes? Or do you think this is just a marketing gimmick?

content:
最近在帮个朋友搞数字化转型，遇到个挺闹心的对账单

他工厂那几台工业机器人走的是机器人即服务模式，结果月底结算，厂家给出的在线工作时长比我们实测的多了整整三天。厂家说是系统自动记录，不可更改，我朋友说是眼见为实，没干活就是没干活。两边只能对着后台数据扯皮，最后只能折中赔钱。

这件事让我意识到，如果数据只能在全透明和全封闭之间选，那商业协作里永远有扯不完的皮。

我这几天一直在翻@MidnightNetwork 的技术文档。

它主打的理性隐私，听起来很性感，利用零知识证明，让你既能向监管证明合规，又能保住核心商业机密。但作为老工程狮，我更习惯用怀疑的眼光看项目。

我首先研究了那个被吹得很神的 Compact 语言。

号称能让普通开发者无门槛写出 ZK 电路。我试着写了两个逻辑 ，发现虽然语法接近，但底层逻辑依然挺烧脑。

所谓的低门槛更像是营销话术，真正要在工业场景落地，光是把复杂的业务逻辑拆解成 ZK 证明，就你们够喝一壶的。

看的我怕怕的，我又跑去 GitHub 翻了翻进度，还顺带写了个脚本分析它们测试网的地址生命周期。

我想看看这网络到底是真需求还是刷数据。实操发现，地址的活跃度确实在涨，但大多集中在几个特定的交互合约上。说难听点，这难道是刷出来的？
#night 
对于官方宣传的双代币模型，$NIGHT  治理、DUST 消耗，我个人持保留意见。把安全和效能解耦，初衷是让企业成本可控，但实际上多加一个代币，就多了一层摩擦和套利空间。
Midnight 确实想解决像我朋友工厂那种痛点，让机器和企业不再裸奔。

但这套架构离真正好用、易用还有不短的距离，恕我直言还得看后面主网的表现。#BTC #ETH 

我想知道作为散户的我们，你会带有隐私属性的链吗？还是觉得这只是个营销罢了？
